description: This file defines an EventQueue class for managing scheduled tasks in an event-driven system, including methods for inserting, executing, and managing scheduled events, along with some utility functions for validation.

classes.name: EventQueue
classes.description: A class managing a sorted linked list of scheduled events, providing methods for event insertion, execution, and management.

methods.name: bool assertNotInList(T * head,T * element)
methods.description: Checks whether a specified element is not present in a linked list, with a safeguard against infinite loops.

methods.name: EventQueue
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the EventQueue object.

methods.name: insertTask
methods.description: Inserts a scheduled task into the event queue in sorted order based on time.

methods.name: executeAll
methods.description: Executes all events scheduled up to the current time.

methods.name: getNextEventTime
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled event.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of scheduled events.

methods.name: getForUnitText
methods.description: Retrieves a scheduled event by index.

methods.name: setLateDelay
methods.description: Sets a delay parameter for late events.

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the head of the scheduled event list.

methods.name: assertListIsSorted
methods.description: Checks if the event list is sorted.

methods.name: checkIfPending
methods.description: Checks if a specific scheduled event is pending execution.
